title: DEEPCORE
author: 31-CEKTIM
selftext:
hi guys

i am a solo developer and i just released my 2d pixel art mining tycoon game the game is currently in beta so it is a fresh project and i am actively working on it it is a web game on itch io so you can play it directly in your browser

i made this game with the help of generative ai for coding and making some of the art assets since i am working alone

in the game you dig deep underground collect different resources and use them to build and upgrade structures on the surface like blacksmith elevator powers explosives etc to speed up your mining loop

i want to keep developing this project and adding new content so i set the price at 2 dollars i really need your support as a community

since the game is in beta your feedback bug reports and ideas mean everything to me

here is the link to the game page : [https://itch.io/dashboard](https://itch.io/dashboard)

please let me know what you think in the comments thanks for checking it out
